newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Friday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said the rates moved in a narrow range in dull trading, with a year-end liquidity squeeze making most banks and other financial institutions do less business.
The short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the central bank, were the most active traders, they said.
"The state banks usually do less business in the last two months of the year, which has caused volume of the market to decrease in the past few weeks," one trader said.
Traders expect the trend to continue in the short term.
